classify.why_this_intent: The query filters investors based on numeric thresholds for riskScore (PortfolioHealth), diversificationScore (PortfolioHealth), and sector allocation percentage (SectorAllocation.allocationPct). This is a boolean comparison across numeric fields, not an aggregation.

generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?investorName ?riskScore ?divScore ?allocPct WHERE {
  ?inv a wm:Investor .
  OPTIONAL { ?inv wm:investorName ?investorName . }
  ?inv wm:hasPortfolioHealth ?ph .
  ?ph wm:riskScore ?riskScore .
  ?ph wm:diversificationScore ?divScore .
  ?inv wm:hasSectorAllocation ?sa .
  ?sa wm:allocationPct ?allocPct .
  FILTER( xsd:decimal(?riskScore) > 70 && xsd:decimal(?divScore) < 30 && xsd:decimal(?allocPct) > 40 )
}
